The Reports Gallery page helps you to view and generate reports under various categories. You can download the reports in PDF, XLS, or Doc formats. All the reports are completely customizable.

The page also lets you mark the report as a favorite you frequently generate. The Favorites option saves you time by giving you access to your favorite reports separately. 

Explore the Reports Gallery page with Help-Doc and FAQs.
